title: Upper Deck Seat Track Section — Installation

issue.reason: Issue C. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Installation of one upper deck seat track section between two splice positions, including the wet installation of the fastener line, the splice pinning and the seat track flatness check across the bay.

sections.purpose: This task gives the installation of a seat track section of the upper deck floor between two splice positions, after a removal or a replacement. It includes the flatness check that the seat installation depends on.
sections.job_setup_note: Make sure that the beam flange is clean, that the protective treatment has been restored and that any finding from the removal task has been closed. Have the sealant mixed and the pot life recorded before you lift the section into place, because the fastener line must be closed inside the pot life. Two persons are needed for the lift and a third for the sealant.
sections.procedure: Put the work platform in position across the bay. Apply the surface protection to any bare area on the beam upper flange and let it dry to the schedule in the standard practice. Apply the sealant to the faying surface of the track section, keeping the bead inboard of the fastener line. CAUTION: DO NOT LET SEALANT ENTER THE SEAT LEG SLOT. SEALANT IN THE SLOT WILL PREVENT THE SEAT LEG FROM SEATING AND IS DIFFICULT TO REMOVE AFTER CURE. Lift the section into position with two persons and align it to the tags made at removal. Install the fasteners along the track wet with sealant, working from the centre outwards, and torque them to the value given in the illustration. Install the clevis pins LN666073-13 at both splice positions. WARNING: DO NOT PUT ANY LOAD ON THE TRACK UNTIL THE SEALANT HAS CURED FOR THE FULL TIME GIVEN IN THE STANDARD PRACTICE. AN UNCURED JOINT WILL NOT CARRY THE SEAT LOAD. Remove the sealant squeeze-out along the track edge before it cures. Do the flatness check across the bay with the straight edge and the feeler gauge set, and record the reading at each seat leg position. Install the seat track covers.
sections.close_out: Install the floor panels, the cabin monuments and the seats. Do the seat attachment check at every seat leg position on the reworked track. Record the flatness readings against the bay identity. Remove the work platform and the protective covers and clear the area below the bay. Close the technical log entry made at removal.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft. On aircraft post the titanium attachment lug standard, use the tension bolt torque values of the second table.

safety_precautions: Put the work platform across the floor beams before you go into the bay.
Record the sealant pot life at the moment of mixing.
Do not put load on the track before the cure time has passed.

tooling.description: Straight edge, 3 m, with feeler gauge set
